tools.name: quote_trip
tools.description: Estimated price (USD) of Harel 'Passport First Class' travel insurance for a trip, per traveller and total, from Harel's official 2026 tariff. Also says if the trip exceeds the maximum days for an age.

tools.name: age_rules
tools.description: For one age: daily price (rest of world / USA), maximum trip length in one policy, pre-existing extension price and its maximum covered days, trip-cancellation prices.

tools.name: coverage_limits
tools.description: Limits of liability of the base policy (medical $5M, medicines, dental, rescue, third party, continued treatment in Israel) with deductibles.

tools.name: condition_rules
tools.description: For a pre-existing medical condition (e.g. diabetes, stent, COPD, cancer): what Harel's health declaration says about it (quoted from the official proposal form), whether the pre-existing-condition extension is required by the form's logic, its price per day by age and max covered days. Pass a Hebre

tools.name: destination_info
tools.description: For a destination country: Harel price class (USA vs rest of world), whether the country requires proof of insurance at entry, the Israeli National Security Council travel warning level, emergency numbers and the Israeli mission — each with its official source.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find pages on hartrip.co.il (Hebrew guides on Harel travel insurance). Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Title, summary and URL of a page returned by search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
